# Workflows

Continuous-integration workflows belong here once the language, package manager,
and quality toolchain have been selected. Do not add speculative workflows that
cannot run against the repository.

`keep-supabase-active.yml` is an operational workflow. See
[`docs/operations/supabase-keepalive.md`](../../docs/operations/supabase-keepalive.md)
for its one-time setup and verification steps.
